clue.text: Denials of wrongdoing from French criminals

parts.note: de is the French for from
fences are criminals who deal in stolen goods

explanation.surface: Accused French crooks keep insisting they did nothing wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: A defence in court is a plea answering a charge, so defences are statements rebutting accusations.

clue.text: Really gloomy, left by women without company

parts.note: so, as in 'so tired', means really

indicators.note: left by says the letter for women departs from the phrase

parts.note: low means depressed or gloomy

explanation.surface: Someone is very depressed after the women walk out and leave them alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something solo means doing it alone, with nobody else for company.

clue.text: Through defending American government, Republican is an enabler of Congress

indicators.note: defending means the word for through stands guard around the other letters

parts.note: via means by way of, through

explanation.surface: A political tale of US government and Republicans in the legislature called Congress.
explanation.walkthrough: Congress here is not the US legislature but sexual congress, i.e. intercourse, which the drug enables.
explanation.definitionFit: The drug treats impotence, so it makes sexual intercourse (congress) possible.

clue.text: Endeavour of a worker to come in sober

indicators.note: to come in says the worker's letters enter the word for sober

parts.note: TT means teetotal, so sober
a temp is a temporary office worker

explanation.surface: A worker tries to turn up for the job without having had a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: An attempt is a try or effort, which is what an endeavour is.

clue.text: Might one crow, when dog gets empty eggshell?

parts.note: a cocker spaniel is a breed of dog

indicators.note: empty means take away the inside of eggshell, keeping just its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A farmyard puzzle: would a bird crow if the dog got hold of a hollow eggshell?
explanation.definitionFit: A young male chicken is the bird that crows at dawn.

clue.text: High-calorie dip is perhaps seasonal

definitions.note: seasonal is an example of something occurring at intervals, hence perhaps

indicators.note: high as in intoxicated, so the letters of calorie dip are scrambled

explanation.surface: A fattening dip is what you might eat at a certain time of year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High-calorie' reads as one adjective, but 'High' is split off to scramble CALORIE DIP.
explanation.definitionFit: Something seasonal recurs at regular intervals, which is one kind of periodical occurrence.

clue.text: Untidy guy's given name

parts.note: to guy someone is to tease or mock them, as is to rag
a tag is a name or label

explanation.surface: A man's given name sounds shabby.
explanation.definitionFit: Ragtag describes something disorderly or ragged in appearance, a synonym for messy.

clue.text: Fellow cutting crime is one wanting a good time

indicators.note: cutting means the fellow splits the crime word into two parts

parts.note: a heist is a robbery
a don is a university fellow, especially at Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: A university fellow taking part in a robbery is just after kicks.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasure-seeker devotes their life to enjoyment, exactly what a hedonist does.

clue.text: Love great ending to series

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, so O
mega is slang for great

explanation.surface: A fan praises the climax of a TV series.
explanation.walkthrough: The final letter of the Greek alphabet stands for the end of any series.
explanation.definitionFit: As the last letter of the Greek alphabet, omega is used to mean the final item.

clue.text: Figure who's dashing round, pursuing the lady

indicators.note: pursuing means the round letter follows behind the lady

parts.note: her refers to the lady
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A dashing man runs around chasing a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A dashing figure is a gallant protagonist, which a hero is.

clue.text: Welcomes drinking keg, providing dodgy offerings — like the across solutions here?

definitions.text: dodgy offerings — like the across solutions here?

indicators.note: drinking means taking the letters in, as one swallows a drink

parts.note: greets means welcomes
KG is an abbreviation for keg
if means providing, as in 'providing it's dry'

explanation.surface: A host greets guests by downing a keg, then hands out suspect presents.
explanation.walkthrough: The Trojan Horse was the Greeks' treacherous gift; every other across answer here (HERO, OMEGA and the rest) comes from Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a present given with treacherous intent, after the wooden horse left at Troy.

clue.text: Complaint of English graduate chasing half-cut Bohemians

indicators.note: chasing means the graduate's letters come after the others
half-cut means only the first half of the word is kept

parts.note: Bohemia is part of the Czech Republic, so Bohemians are Czechs
an MA is a Master of Arts graduate

explanation.surface: An English graduate pursues some drunk Bohemians, and ends up with a grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: Half-cut is British slang for tipsy, but here it means the word is cut in half.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint can mean an illness or ailment; this skin inflammation is one.

clue.text: Rightly touring north in a way that involves different groups

definitions.text: in a way that involves different groups

indicators.note: touring means the word goes all round the letter for north

parts.note: ethically means in a morally right way

explanation.surface: A moral traveller goes north while meeting many different communities.
explanation.definitionFit: Done ethnically means relating to ethnic groups, peoples of different cultures or races.

clue.text: Nameless, strutting male model

indicators.note: nameless says the letter for name is dropped

parts.note: parading means strutting about showily

explanation.surface: An unknown man struts down the catwalk as a model.
explanation.walkthrough: N is the abbreviation for name. The surface wants 'male model' as a phrase; the definition is just 'model' in the sense of an exemplar.
explanation.definitionFit: A paradigm is a pattern or exemplar to copy, a standard example.

clue.text: One's therefore hugging maiden's neck

parts.note: one is I, so one's is I'S

indicators.note: hugging means the word for therefore wraps round the letter

parts.note: thus means therefore
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A lover concludes that he's embracing a young woman's neck.
explanation.walkthrough: Neck is not the body part but a narrow strip of land joining two larger areas.
explanation.definitionFit: A neck of land joining two larger landmasses is the geographical term here.

clue.text: Fabulous beasts with one ear in sun, gambolling

indicators.note: in means these letters are placed inside the others
gambolling means leaping about, so the letters of sun are jumbled

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral
an ear of corn, so ear gives corn

explanation.surface: Mythical creatures with a single ear frolic in the sunshine.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabulous here means from fable or legend; the horned horses are mythical creatures.

clue.text: Tragic figure's return followed by artist

indicators.note: followed by means the artist's letters come next

parts.note: to return a candidate is to elect them
RA stands for Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A tragic hero comes back, then an artist follows.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the heroine of Greek tragedies by Sophocles and Euripides, avenging her father Agamemnon.

clue.text: Crosses houses we'd rebuilt for timber suppliers

indicators.note: houses means the crosses word holds the other letters

parts.note: a rood is a cross or crucifix

indicators.note: rebuilt means the letters of we'd are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: Builders say a house with crosses needs rebuilding with timber.
explanation.definitionFit: These giant Californian trees are a major source of wood for building.

clue.text: Terrible avarice is perhaps a staple for the rich?

definitions.text: perhaps a staple for the rich
definitions.note: the question mark and perhaps signal a playful example rather than a definition proper

indicators.note: terrible means the letters of avarice are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Greed is wicked, the clue says, asking whether luxury foods are wealthy people's everyday fare.
explanation.walkthrough: This is the older spelling of the fish-roe delicacy.
explanation.definitionFit: Sturgeon roe is a costly luxury, so jokingly a basic food for wealthy people.

clue.text: Church walls in Barcelona perhaps quartz

indicators.note: walls in means the outermost letters, the walls, of the word Barcelona

parts.note: quartz is an example of silica, hence perhaps

explanation.surface: A church in Barcelona perhaps has walls made of quartz.
explanation.definitionFit: A basilica is a large oblong church, such as one given special papal privileges.

clue.text: Queen needs jacket in chilly lakeside resort

parts.note: Anne was a Queen of Great Britain

indicators.note: jacket in means the outside letters, the jacket, of chilly

explanation.surface: The queen needs a coat in a cold holiday town by a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: This French town sits on Lake Annecy in the Alps, a holiday destination.

clue.text: Setter's receiving benefit, needing a turn in the air

indicators.note: receiving means the setter's word takes the other letters inside

parts.note: the setter refers to themselves, so setter's is my

indicators.note: needing a turn says the benefit word is read backwards

parts.note: the dole is unemployment benefit

explanation.surface: The setter is on benefits and needs a spin in the fresh air.
explanation.definitionFit: An air is a tune, so the word means a musical line.

clue.text: Mostly praise corporation over being member-owned

indicators.note: over in a down clue means the letters are read from bottom to top
mostly means losing the final letter

parts.note: laud means praise
corporation is humorous old slang for a pot belly, a tum

explanation.surface: Mainly, a writer praises a company for being owned by its members.
explanation.walkthrough: A mutual is a building society or insurer owned by its members, not shareholders.
explanation.definitionFit: A mutual society is one run for and owned by its customers or members.

clue.text: Opponent of slack stagnation

indicators.note: slack means loose, so the letters of stagnation are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone opposes lazy inertia.
explanation.definitionFit: An antagonist is an adversary, someone who opposes another.

clue.text: A drive through Paris or Edinburgh in reverse

indicators.note: in reverse says the hidden letters are read backwards
through means the letters run through the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A road trip that takes in either Paris or Edinburgh, going backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'A drive through' as the definition, but 'through' is the hidden-word signal; the definition is just 'A drive', as in sexual drive.
explanation.definitionFit: In psychology the name of the Greek love god is used for libido, the sexual instinct.

clue.text: Language using few words needs no introduction

indicators.note: no introduction means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: terse means brief, using few words

explanation.surface: A concise language needs no preamble.
explanation.definitionFit: Erse is the Gaelic tongue of Scotland or Ireland.

clue.text: Running behind officer showing some guts

indicators.note: behind means the running word comes after the officer

parts.note: Col is the abbreviation for colonel, an officer
on means running, as a machine is on

explanation.surface: An officer is jogging behind, showing courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Guts' looks like courage, but it is the intestines.
explanation.definitionFit: The colon is part of the large intestine, a section of the bowels.

clue.text: Composition in D sharp originally containing nothing unknown

indicators.note: containing means the rearranged letters hold the nothing letter
originally suggests the letters of D sharp were once in another order, so they are rearranged

parts.note: nothing is zero, O
Y is an unknown in algebra

explanation.surface: A piece of music written in D sharp at first has nothing unknown about it.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhapsody is a free-form piece of music, an instrumental work.
